name: Delicious Birch-Steamed Pork Ribs
desc: A dish made with branches and ribs. With the lightest nudge of a fork, the meat falls from the bone like snow sliding from a branch. As it touches your tongue, its deep, savory richness mingles with the faint woodland aroma of steamed birch, finally melting into a warmth that leaves you wholly content.

value.text: Decreases all party members' gliding and sprinting Stamina consumption by 25% for 900s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
